node: Advanced packaging substrate stack: ABF/build-up film, high-end IC substrates, plating equipment and chemistry
summary: US-listed direct exposure to the ABF/high-end IC substrate node is limited because the core substrate makers and ABF film supplier are mostly Japan, Taiwan, or Europe listed. For this Layer 1B pass, the strongest US-listed mapping is not substrate manufacturing itself but adjacent chokepoint exposure: MKS via Atotech plating equipment and chemistry for package substrates, Onto and Camtek via inspection/metrology for advanced packaging and advanced IC substrates, and Amkor as a direct advanced-packaging customer/beneficiary whose ramp may be constrained by substrate availability. Non-US context anchors remain Ajinomoto, Ibiden, Shinko, Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB, and AT&S.
